subject: POC launch window coordination — availability & owners
messages:
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orbitalai.com>, Michael Chen <michael.chen@orbitalai.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC launch window coordination — availability & owners

Hi Samantha & Michael,

Thanks again for the productive discovery last week. We want to lock in a 90-minute POC kickoff where we:
- Review success criteria and acceptance tests (owning doc attached)
- Validate network and data access requirements (network matrix attached)
- Align owners and runbook for the pilot week

Proposed windows (all US-PST):
1) Tue Jul 28, 09:00–10:30
2) Wed Jul 29, 13:00–14:30
3) Thu Jul 30, 11:00–12:30

Attendees we suggest: AE (me), SE (Lauren), Customer Success (Jordan), your engineering lead, your procurement contact, and a security representative for the network walkthrough. Can you confirm who from your side should be the primary owners for success criteria and procurement sign-off?

I attached the POC success criteria draft and a short network checklist to speed the run. If none of the windows work, send 3 alternatives and we’ll do our best to accommodate.

Next steps: once we lock a time I’ll send a calendar invite with pre-read and a brief pre-check (30m) for network access one business day before the kickoff.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RDW-POC-success-criteria-v3.pdf, network-requirements-orbital.xlsx
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@orbitalai.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@orbitalai.com>, procurement@orbitalai.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC launch window coordination — availability & owners

Markus,

Appreciate the clear options. Quick answers:
- Owners: I (Samantha) will own success criteria on the product side; Michael will be the engineering contact. Procurement (procurement@orbitalai.com) will need to be looped in for our internal approval steps. Security: I'll confirm a name but expect availability the week of Jul 27.

Of the proposed slots, Wed Jul 29 13:00–14:30 looks best for product + eng. If you can do a pre-check the day before (Tue Jul 28), that would be ideal.

Two questions before we lock:
1) Can you point us to the exact network ports and sample IAM policy we need to provision? The spreadsheet is helpful but we'll need a condensed checklist for our infra team.
2) For success criteria: are you comfortable if we add a 'latency under 350ms 95th percentile' line? We can agree on an acceptance threshold during the kickoff but want to flag it.

If that works, procurement will start a light intake form once you send a calendar invite and any procurement checklist.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Product
Orbital AI
samantha.lee@orbitalai.com | +1 (617) 555-0123

Thanks all — happy to join the kickoff and run the technical walkthrough. Quick notes from the SE side:

- We can produce a condensed network checklist (2-page) for your infra team; I'll attach a cut-down version in the invite.
- Regarding latency: we'll capture baseline numbers during the first test run in the kickoff and document the 95th percentile over a 30-minute sample. 350ms 95p is reasonable as an initial acceptance target; we'll record the observed baseline and set the final acceptance in the success criteria doc.
- Suggestion: 30-minute pre-check the business day before (Tue Jul 28) focused solely on connectivity and credentials. That should reduce the chance of delays during the 90-minute kickoff.

My availability: I can do Wed Jul 29 13:00–14:30 (confirmed) or Thu Jul 30 morning. If procurement requires a different time, let me know and we can try to flex.

Lauren Bishop
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Great — thanks for the quick responses. Wed Jul 29 13:00–14:30 (US-PST) is locked on our side.

Planned agenda (90m):
- 13:00–13:10 Introductions and goals (Markus / Samantha)
- 13:10–13:40 Success criteria walkthrough & acceptance owners (Samantha / Markus)
- 13:40–14:10 Technical demo + integration checklist (Lauren / Michael)
- 14:10–14:25 Network/security validation and next steps (Security rep / Lauren)
- 14:25–14:30 Wrap and immediate action items (Jordan)

Pre-check: Tue Jul 28 09:00–09:30 PST — 30-minute slot for infra to validate network & credentials. Lauren will lead. Calendar invites are sent. I attached: RDW-POC-success-criteria-v3.pdf (now with the latency line marked as proposed) and network-requirements-orbital.xlsx as a condensed tab.

Procurement: I included procurement@orbitalai.com on the CC so they can advise on any intake requirements. If you want us to run a procurement checklist template, Jordan can kick that off after the kickoff.

If anything changes, reply-all and we'll update the invites. Looking forward to getting started.

Cheers,
Markus Klein

Thanks Markus — calendar invite received and I confirmed with security; Sarah Patel (security@orbitalai.com) will join the network validation segment. Procurement acknowledged the invite and will complete the intake after the kickoff (procurement@orbitalai.com).

Two quick asks before the pre-check:
- Can Lauren paste the condensed port list and a one-paragraph IAM example in the calendar pre-check invite so infra has it in the event description?
- We'll add the 350ms 95p as a proposed acceptance; please mark it as 'proposed' in the success criteria doc so we can iterate during the kickoff.

See you Wed — Samantha
